test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the figure which is different from the rest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04737cde79c60d202b7e2852dcb51e4a8fa9064be80e288907feac6f09a4806c.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: In most figures, the two semi-circles are placed on **opposite sides** of the inner square, while one figure does not follow this pattern.

Now, checking the options:

Option 1: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fa2fa7901109ceae7db94ce8105a40e5e53f70799a42ec85148f0188af86e09.png] 

Semi-circles on opposite sides – Follows the rule

Option 2: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd89a3a7755b6db3f4f6a6b60245624eb08b854ac8e1d7e8136420abcd7c2a38.png] 

Semi-circles on opposite sides – Follows the rule

**Option 3:** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a155dd7e3e9e8022f29d98e5b94e1580e1c72c59dd241fb387165edf66edae48.png] 

Semi-circles on adjacent sides – Breaks the rule → Odd one out

Option 4: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36c771daf4a997c131eeb0bed7eec61f78560df1ef0a6bd1f06f6e8062265a57.png] 

Semi-circles on opposite sides – Follows the rule

Hence, **Option 3** is the correct answer.
